what: Hover a dark button and a 15°-tilted accent panel stands upright from 175% below and fills the button. The label rolls up one line over the same text stacked beneath it at 1.5em. In the square icon on the right, the background square turns 90° while the arrow slips 200% to the right and the next arrow enters. All three run at .525s cubic-bezier(.625,.05,0,1). On release it returns the same way.

options.--fx-drop: Depth at which the panel hides (share of panel height), default 175% — tall buttons 205~230%
options.look: light (on a dark panel — flips background·text) · bare (no background, only text·icon — link over a photo)

use: Your button text here
note: CSS only (no fx.js). The three arrow svgs are the same drawing — the last one is shown and the first slides in on hover

from.where: shared.css header ”Book a Call” · CTA ”Get in Touch” · detail ”Visit Site” · contact ”Send” (look: light) · hero ”View Work” (look: bare) — original Osmo Button 043 (.button-043)
